terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.meta_description: Terms of Service for Chonburi Home real estate platform (general users and agents).

sections.title: Article 1 (General)
paragraphs: These Terms govern use of the real estate information platform provided by Chonburi Home ("the Site"). All registered users (general users and agents) are deemed to have agreed to these Terms.

sections.title: Article 2 (User categories and definitions)
paragraphs: General users: Individuals or entities that browse property information, make inquiries, save favorites, and use similar features through the Site.
Agents: Real estate businesses or individual agents who list properties on the Site and respond to inquiries from general users.

sections.title: Article 3 (General users)
paragraphs: General users shall register using accurate information.
Review of property details and contract negotiations shall be conducted directly between the user and the agent. The Site assumes no responsibility for the content of any agreement.
Features such as favorites (❤️) and My Page may be used freely within personal, non-abusive use.

subsections.heading: Accuracy of information
subsections.body: Agents warrant that listed information (rent, sale price, availability, pet policy, etc.) is up to date and accurate.

subsections.heading: Licenses
subsections.body: Agents shall comply with applicable legal requirements in Thailand for brokerage (including business licenses where required).

subsections.heading: No bait advertising
subsections.body: Listing properties that are already transacted or fictitious is prohibited. The Site may suspend accounts if such conduct is found.

subsections.heading: Duty to respond
subsections.body: Agents shall respond to inquiries from general users honestly and promptly via LINE, telephone, or other reasonable channels.

sections.title: Article 5 (Disclaimer)
paragraphs: The Site strives for accuracy of listings but does not warrant completeness of information.
The Site is not liable for disputes between users or for any damages arising from use of the Site.
The Site is not responsible for disadvantages arising from changes to Thai law, tax rules, or condominium regulations.

faq_page.meta_description: Answers about searching and inquiries, living in Pattaya & Sriracha, and using the site.
faq_page.title: Frequently asked questions
faq_page.subtitle: Choose a category and tap a question to read the answer.

items_property.q: Does it cost anything to use the site?
items_property.a: No. Property seekers can use all features for free.

items_property.q: Will the platform team contact me after I inquire?
items_property.a: No. We are a marketplace: your message goes straight to the listing agent. Please wait for them to reply.
LINE is the fastest, most reliable channel for Thai real estate. Availability and viewing slots are easy to arrange in chat.

items_property.q: Can I ask about several listings in one message?
items_property.a: Different properties may have different agents. Please use the inquiry button on each listing page.

items_property.q: Do I need to log in to inquire?
items_property.a: Yes. We require sign-in for reliable follow-up and to reduce spam. After the first time, your details are easier to reuse.

items_life.q: Can I book a viewing from Japan?
items_life.a: Yes. You can also discuss a video viewing with the agent over LINE.

items_life.q: If a listing says “pet friendly”, can I definitely bring my pet?
items_life.a: “Pet friendly” means it may be possible, but breed/size rules vary. Always confirm details with the agent first.
Relatively limited in Pattaya & Sriracha. Use the “bathtub” filter when you search.

items_life.q: What documents do I need to sign a lease?
items_life.a: A passport copy is usually required. Your agent will guide you through the rest.

items_system.a: It may have been rented/sold and removed from the site.

items_system.q: My LINE ID can’t be found.
items_system.a: In LINE, turn on “Allow others to add me by ID”, or copy your add-friend URL from your profile and register that instead.
Agents update their own listings; Thailand’s market moves quickly. Always confirm the latest availability on LINE or by phone.
Yes. Your inquiry details are not shown to anyone except the agent you contacted.

items_system.q: How do I delete my account?
items_system.a: From My Page → Settings you can leave the service and request data removal.

items_system.q: I found a bug on the site.
items_system.a: Please report it via “Bug report (LINE)” in the footer. We may not reply individually, but we use reports to improve the site.
